rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: VibeLogin is an authentication-as-a-service platform designed for AI-native development. Through the MCP server, developers can prompt their IDE to scaffold complete sign-in flows — email/password, magic links, OTP, and Google OAuth — without writing auth infrastructure from scratch. The server creates and configures VibeLogin projects, generates working authentication code for Next.js and Vite/React apps, and handles credential caching locally via a loopback OAuth + PKCE flow.
